answer: Plant 3 honeypots per 100 tasks with answers that are wrong on purpose. Attest one and the payout for that epoch is clawed back. That is 0.03 of the queue as bait, with the auditor pool rotating every 2 epochs. A developer reading a kernel trace, a meadow sensor and a signal log spots the bad answer without effort. A script that answers by pattern hits all 3, and the clawback repeats on every clone running the same script.
